cards.title: The guide
cards.text: Who answers in the site's corner: Louis's AI, one voice on three packs, no files, git or shell.

cards.title: The docs pack
cards.text: What it answers from: the framework as its docs tell it.

cards.title: The leads pack
cards.text: One tool that mails Louis a lead, once the visitor has said yes.

cards.title: The site pack
cards.text: One tool that takes the visitor to a page, or a place on it.
